about: Regional price research for the shop, checked 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-19: what each item really costs, delivered, in each country researched so far (the USA, India, Brazil, and Germany standing in for the EU), with stores, links and notes. regions and each item's regions are keyed by lower-case ISO 3166-1 country code, the same codes the shop's region rules and the admin Stats tab's countries use; to research another country, add its code to regions and to the items (an item without it shows no price there). The admin page's Shop items shows it per item (regional-prices.js); the shop itself charges everyone the same. Rates: 1 USD = 94.5 INR = 5.50 BRL; 1 EUR = 1.1164 USD. Card grants aren't listed: they're worth the same everywhere. Items are matched by name, ignoring case, accents and punctuation; add aliases for other spellings. planning/shop-price-per-hour-2026-11-19.csv was made from this.

items.name: SOLDR Kit (Deluxe)
items.notes: SOLDR Deluxe Edition (SKU SL01DEL) by SNRGY Studios (Sweden): a modular USB-C soldering station kit. The official store ships only to the US and Europe. India and Brazil can only get it via CircuitMess, which is sold out, and import fees make it 2–2.7× the US price.

us.notes: $319 with tax and duties included; $288 in the November sale. Shipping isn't shown before checkout.

in.notes: soldr.pro doesn't ship to India, and CircuitMess is sold out ($449). Fees are the estimated 40% duty.

br.notes: soldr.pro doesn't ship to Brazil, and CircuitMess is sold out ($449). Fees are estimates: 60% import tax, 17% ICMS and 3.5% IOF.

de.notes: €319 with VAT, no import fees inside the EU; ~€288 in the November sale. Shipping isn't shown before checkout.

items.name: Pebble Time 2
items.notes: Pebble Time 2 smartwatch from Core Devices, $225 in any colour, official store only (repebble.com). $225 everywhere, with taxes collected before shipping, so taxes make the difference: Brazil about 2× the US, India about 1.4×. Shipping only shows at checkout, so every total leaves it out.

us.notes: In stock, ships within 48 hours, no Black Friday price. About $10 US tariff. Shipping isn't shown before checkout.

in.notes: Duties prepaid: ~40% duty plus Pebble's handling fee. Not confirmed that it ships to India; smartwatches may need BIS/WPC clearance.

br.notes: Estimated 60% import tax, 20% ICMS and Pebble's handling fee. Not confirmed that it ships to Brazil; likely no Anatel certification.

de.notes: 0% EU duty on smartwatches: 19% VAT plus Pebble's handling fee, collected before shipping. No EU reseller has stock.

us.notes: Free delivery; syitren.com also $99.99 (normally $119.99). Prime holiday deal $80.99. Sales tax not included.

de.notes: €99 with VAT, a few left. Shipping to Germany only shows in the cart.

items.name: TRMNL OG
items.notes: TRMNL (OG) 7.5in black-and-white, standard colours $139 (Coral limited edition $199 excluded), no add-ons. US and EU are about the same; India is ~1.5× after a 40% duty, Brazil at least ~2× before shipping, with an Anatel risk. No Black Friday discount.

us.notes: Free US shipping; every standard colour in stock. Sales tax not included.

in.notes: $13 India shipping (Oct 2025 blog, may be stale) plus 40% duty. TRMNL reports one customer paying ₹7,800 duty, which would make it ~$235.

br.notes: Not confirmed that TRMNL ships to Brazil; the total leaves out shipping, so it's a lower bound. 60% import tax, 20% ICMS, 3.5% IOF. No Anatel certification found (Wi-Fi), so customs could hold it.

de.notes: VAT, free shipping and a battery upgrade included. TRMNL also ships EU orders duty-free from Berlin.

items.name: TRMNL (BWRY)
items.notes: TRMNL (BWRY), the 7.5in black/white/red/yellow model, $139; slow refresh (~13 s). Priced exactly like the OG everywhere, so the same gaps: India ~1.5× and Brazil 2× or more. No Black Friday discount.

br.notes: Not confirmed that TRMNL ships to Brazil; a lower bound without shipping. No Anatel certification found, so customs could hold it.
